# Employee Directory

- Preserve ASP.NET Core MVC conventions and the in-memory repository design.
- Add stable `data-testid` attributes to new automation-relevant controls and results.
- Keep reset behavior deterministic, including all related temporary data.
- Enforce business rules server-side; client validation is supplementary.
- Build `EmployeeDirectory.csproj` after code changes.
